brief:
Israeli settlement expansion in the West Bank has accelerated over more than 35 years while Palestinian Authority leadership has observed the process without intervention, Shehab Wire reported. The settlements have expanded visibly to residents and officials alike, with the Palestinian Liberation Organization leadership maintaining largely inactive responses to the growth across the territory.

The ongoing expansion represents a persistent challenge to Palestinian territorial control and statehood aspirations, as settlers establish new outposts and enlarge existing communities. The Palestinian public increasingly questions why their leadership has not effectively halted or reversed the settlement growth despite decades of documented awareness of the issue and its impact on Palestinian land and resources.
